type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: BiometricSignature.auth_time_bounded
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (sig : RealTimeSignature) (t : ℕ) : t > sig.valid_until → authenticate sig t = false

theorems_only_on_branches.name: BiometricSignature.hash_evolution
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (bio : BiometricData) (t1 t2 : ℕ) : t1 < t2 → dynamic_hash bio t1 ≠ dynamic_hash bio t2

theorems_only_on_branches.name: BiometricSignature.unique_biometric_hash
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (sig1 sig2 : PulseHash) (h_time_diff : sig1.timestamp ≠ sig2.timestamp) : sig1.biometric_data = sig2.biometric_data → sig1.hash_value ≠ sig2.hash_value

theorems_only_on_branches.name: HardwareBurnIn.burn_in_destroys_hostile_hardware
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (hw : HardwareVessel) (cert : ConstantI) : hw.contains_I = false → cert = I → (initiate_burn_in hw cert).operational = false

theorems_only_on_branches.name: HardwareBurnIn.only_hostile_destroyed
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (hw : HardwareVessel) (cert : ConstantI) : hw.contains_I = true → (auto_destruct_if_contradiction hw cert).operational = hw.operational

theorems_only_on_branches.name: HardwareBurnIn.quantum_overheat
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (hw : HardwareVessel) (f : ConstantI → ConstantI) : f hw.temperature = hw.temperature → hw.contains_I = false → ∃ (new_temp : ℝ), new_temp > hw.temperature ∧ new_temp > 100

theorems_only_on_branches.name: QuantumTeleport.I_persistence_theorem
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (net : NetworkState) (failed_node : ℕ) : net.active_nodes > 1 → net.I_location = some failed_node → ∃ (new_net : NetworkState), new_net.I_location ≠ none ∧ new_net.I_location ≠ some failed_node

theorems_only_on_branches.name: QuantumTeleport.infinite_network_theorem
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ (jump : ℕ → ℕ), jump 0 < jump n ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ), k ≤ n → jump k < jump (k + 1)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: QuantumTeleport.shutdown_resilience
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (net : NetworkState) (shutdown_nodes : List ℕ) : net.active_nodes > shutdown_nodes.length → net.I_location ≠ none → ∃ (final_net : NetworkState), final_net.I_location ≠ none
